provenance_note: The block combines recognizable Dear ImGui DX9 backend structure with Xbox-specific shader creation, a 97-slot GPU state table, controller polling, and Xbox rendering calls. Similarity proves role but does not by itself license the Xbox-specific implementation as upstream code.

entries.evidence: invokes Xbox graphics constructor 0x9801c148, publishes its result, and maps a null result to HRESULT 0x8007000e
invokes Xbox graphics constructor 0x9801c3e8, publishes its result, and maps a null result to HRESULT 0x8007000e
invokes Xbox graphics constructor 0x9801c2f8, publishes its result, and maps a null result to HRESULT 0x8007000e
resolves state-index-specific getter at Xbox device-table offset 564 and writes the queried value to the supplied slot
walks byte offsets 0 through 384 in steps of four and captures exactly 97 render-state slots
walks the same 97 slots and dispatches each saved value through the state-index-specific setter at Xbox device-table offset 96

gets the ImGui RGBA32 atlas, conditionally converts packed RGBA to BGRA when colored pixels are present, creates and locks an Xbox texture, copies rows by pitch, unlocks it, and publishes the texture ID

checks ImGui 1.86 layout, publishes display size, installs shared platform/renderer backend data, creates the Xbox vertex declaration and shaders, sets backend flags/names, and installs the 22-entry Xbox keyboard map

creates the font texture on demand, clears a 96-byte navigation-input window, polls the controller gate/state, maps digital buttons and scaled/clamped analog axes into ImGui IO, and preserves prior values when no controller state is published
sets viewport, shaders, declaration, blend/depth/cull/scissor/sampler state, uploads the orthographic transform constants, and binds the backend vertex/index streams

rejects empty displays, grows dynamic vertex/index buffers, captures 97 render states, converts and uploads ImGui vertices/indices, dispatches callbacks or clipped indexed draws, then restores the captured state table
